verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents per-card spend limits: limits can be capped per employee with custom limits, adjusted instantly, and set per card with reset intervals through the MCP server. The 'granular controls' half of the story rests only on marketing-level phrases ('card controls', 'embed expense policies', 'built-in expense controls') with no concrete control types described, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: documented granular control types (e.g., merchant/category restrictions, per-transaction caps, time or geography rules), detailed first-party docs on how per-employee card policies are configured, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set per-card spend limits and granular controls for each employee
